description: What a local business's OWN website says right now: phone, address, hours, and holiday/temporary-closure notices quoted word for word, each with its source. Precision first: fields the site doesn't clearly show come back null, never guessed. Flags hidden structured data that disagrees with the page, sites that moved to another domain, and multi-location sites. Deterministic, no AI calls. By OMENZ.
